summary: Faber is a Lisbon-linked early-stage firm that invests in teams transforming industries with frontier technology. Its homepage states pre-seed and seed stages, a first ticket of up to €2,500,000, and a geography of Southern Europe with selective investments across Europe, and its Approach page adds selective investing in the US and a deep tech focus on applied science, digital transformation, and climate and ocean tech. A street address is not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage reports a €25.7M Series A led by Balnord and Expansion Ventures with participation from Faber. Faber’s initial investment date is not stated.

sources.title: Homepage: stages, first ticket, geographies and specialist focus
Approach page: Southern Europe launchpad, selective Europe and US investing, lead preference
